procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin

sites.name: Kadalur Point Lighthouse

scope.item: Provision of Streetlights and Landscaping Lights for Tourism

money.notes: EMD by DD/FDR of any nationalised/RBI approved bank in favour of The Director, Directorate of Lighthouses & Lightships, Deep Bhavan, Cochin, payable at Ernakulam; to reach tender inviting authority one day before last date of bid submission. Small scale industries with valid NSIC/MSME certificate exempted from EMD. Table mentions 'EMD and tender fee' submission but no tender fee amount is printed.

eligibility: Reputed OEMs or their authorised suppliers, licensed electrical contractors, parties or Government undertakings
notes: NIT dated 02.11.2023; two-cover online bids. Download/submission 03.11.2023 09:00 to 16.11.2023 15:00; EMD in original by 15.11.2023 15:00; technical bid opening 17.11.2023 16:00. Section I short notice only; no BOQ, completion period or eligibility details.
